app.errorDescription: Reload the interface and try again.

gate.activationRequired: The previous activation is no longer valid. Please activate this installation again. Your data will be preserved.

activation.title: Activate App
activation.description: Enter your activation code to link this installation to your license.
activation.replacementDescription: Enter a new activation code for the current license or another valid license. Your data will be preserved. The previous activation is replaced only after successful activation.
activation.replacementNotice: The existing activation is replaced only after successful verification.

banner.readOnlyDescription: You can still view and export existing data. Creating and editing are blocked.
banner.persistencePending: The blocked license state could not yet be fully saved. This device remains blocked. Please try saving again.

errors.activationRequired: The previous activation is no longer valid on the license server. Please enter a new activation code.
errors.network: The license server is currently unreachable. Local validity remains unchanged.
errors.deviceRevoked: The activation of this device has been revoked.
errors.storage: The local license state could not be read or saved safely.
errors.api: The license server rejected the activation or update. Check the code and the license status.
errors.protocol: The license server response could not be processed.
errors.unactivated: This installation is not activated yet.
errors.stateChanged: The license state has changed. Please check it again.
errors.synchronization: License synchronization is currently unavailable. Please try again.
errors.readOnly: This action requires a valid activation. Existing data remains readable and exportable.
errors.featureDenied: This feature is not enabled in your license.
errors.unknown: The license check failed. Please try again.

licenseProfile.title: License
licenseProfile.noFeatures: No features available in the current certificate.
licenseProfile.validityHint: The certificate validity limits offline use. Its expiration does not automatically mean your purchased license has ended. The actual license term is not currently provided separately.
licenseProfile.persistencePending: The blocked license state could not yet be fully saved. Please synchronize again.
licenseProfile.deviceReleaseHint: Releasing a device is not yet available in this app. Deleting local license data does not free a device slot on the server.

active.label: Active
active.description: Your signed license certificate is valid. The app can be used normally.

offline_grace.label: Valid offline
offline_grace.description: Your existing certificate still permits local use. Synchronization is due; the certificate is renewed only after successful server verification.

expired.label: Certificate expired
expired.description: Your local certificate has expired. Synchronize to obtain a new one. This alone does not tell us whether your purchased license has also expired. Existing data remains readable and exportable.

revoked.label: Device activation revoked
revoked.description: This device activation has been revoked. Editing is blocked; existing data remains readable and exportable.

license_revoked.label: License revoked
license_revoked.description: The server has confirmed that this license was revoked. Editing is blocked; existing data remains readable and exportable.

unactivated.label: Not activated
unactivated.description: This installation is not associated with a license yet. An activation code is required to use it.

activation_required.label: Activation required
activation_required.description: The previous server association is missing or no longer matches this installation. Renew the activation. Existing data is preserved.

invalid.label: Cannot be verified
invalid.description: The local certificate cannot currently be verified reliably. Editing remains blocked. Synchronize to check the license status again.

tags.placeholder: Type a tag and press Enter
